title: A body among twigs
hook: Body shape can affect how an animal stands out.

knows: Animals live against backgrounds in their environments.
doesNotKnow: Recognize a shape resemblance in a stated environment.

misconception: Camouflage guarantees an animal cannot be found.
objective: Recognize a shape resemblance in a stated environment.

claims.text: Body shape can affect how an animal stands out. A stick insect rests among similar twigs. Which visible feature can contribute to camouflage in this setting? The schematic stick insect has a slender body resembling the surrounding twigs. In this stated setting, that resemblance can make it less conspicuous; camouflage does not guarantee that a predator will miss it.

claims.text: The stage uses a simplified, not-to-scale schematic and stated model assumptions; it is not a photographic observation of an individual animal.
